vintage: INSEE comparateur de territoires, census 2023 and 2024 establishments

lenses.name: Natural population balance
lenses.description: Births minus deaths in 2023 as a share of residents, with commune vital events summed within each map hex. Negative values mean deaths exceed births before migration.

lenses.name: Estimated net migration
lenses.description: Approximate net migration 2017–2023: total population change minus summed natural increase, divided by 2017 population. This residual omits statistical adjustments and is sensitive to municipal boundary changes.

lenses.name: Business establishments
lenses.description: INSEE establishment count in 2024 per 1,000 residents, summed from communes within each map hex. Establishments are local business units, not enterprises or employment.

lenses.name: Commune median income
lenses.description: Commune-level median standard of living in 2023, distributed over commune polygons and population-weighted within each hex. This is a weighted average of commune medians, not a recomputed hex median; suppressed communes and most overseas territories are null.

lenses.name: Commune poverty
lenses.description: Commune-level share of residents below 60% of median standard of living in 2023, population-weighted within each hex. Suppressed communes and most overseas territories are null rather than zero.

lenses.name: Commune homeownership
lenses.description: Owner-occupied share of main residences in 2023, using commune-level counts distributed over commune polygons. Unlike the headline department lens, neighboring communes can differ within the same department.

lenses.name: Commune second homes
lenses.description: Second homes and occasional dwellings as a share of all dwellings in 2023, using commune-level counts distributed over commune polygons.

lenses.name: Commune vacant homes
lenses.description: Vacant dwellings as a share of all dwellings in 2023, using commune-level counts distributed over commune polygons.
